title: EKS: IRSA vs Pod Identity
summary: Both give a service account its own IAM role. IRSA federates a per-cluster OIDC issuer; Pod Identity uses an EKS API association and a fixed service principal.

dimensions.label: Per-cluster setup
values: Register the cluster's OIDC issuer as an IAM OIDC provider

dimensions.label: Reusing a role across clusters
values: Edit the trust policy for every cluster
Create an association; trust policy unchanged

dimensions.label: Also works on
values: Fargate, and self-managed clusters with a public issuer

notes: For new EKS workloads on EC2, Pod Identity is usually simpler. IRSA remains the option for Fargate and for non-EKS clusters.
Both are only as strong as their mapping: an IRSA trust policy without a sub condition, or a sloppy association, hands the role to the wrong pods.
